title: 30.3 A 24Gb 42.5Gb/s GDDR7 DRAM with Low-Power WCK Distribution, an RC-Optimized Dual-Emphasis TX, and Voltage/Time-Margin-Enhanced Power Reduction
problem: GDDR7 DRAM must achieve 42.5Gb/s data rates while managing power consumption and thermal throttling in high-performance AI systems requiring extensive datasets and GPU processing.
motivation: As AI applications demand higher memory bandwidth and density, power consumption and junction temperature become critical bottlenecks limiting sustained performance.
method: The design introduces low-power write-clock (WCK) distribution, an RC-optimized dual-emphasis transmitter (TX), and voltage/time-margin-enhanced techniques to reduce power while maintaining high bandwidth PAM3 signaling at 42.5Gb/s.
key_novelty: Dual-emphasis transmitter optimization combined with margin-enhanced power reduction to achieve low-power 42.5Gb/s operation in GDDR7.
contributions: Low-power WCK distribution architecture for GDDR7 memory
RC-optimized dual-emphasis TX design for high-speed signaling
Demonstrated 42.5Gb/s data rate with thermal management
limitations: Abstract-only analysis; specific power savings and thermal improvements not quantified.
primary_theme: Low-power high-bandwidth GDDR7 for AI memory systems
